assertion_source_map.assertions: Labeled hypertension, angina, and MI uses for tartrate; hypertension, angina, HF, and pediatric hypertension from age 6 for succinate ER.

assertion_source_map.card: Intravenous therapy and off-label rate control
assertion_source_map.assertions: IV stable acute MI followed by oral maintenance; recognition of off-label AF rate control without an AF dosing protocol.
Numeric adult HTN, angina, and MI doses, intervals, studied ranges, duration, meal timing, and monitored MI transition.
Adult and pediatric ER doses, initial dose limits, HF titration, and tablet splitting without crushing.
Three 5 mg IV boluses approximately 2 minutes apart; coronary care setting, BP/HR/ECG monitoring, and oral transition.
Lower hepatic starting doses and gradual titration; no renal reduction required solely for chronic renal failure.
Withdrawal taper, HF and bradycardia risks, incomplete cardioselectivity, bronchospasm, hypoglycemia, alpha blockade first, thyroid and arterial risks, perioperative and anaphylaxis precautions.
Exact oral and IV exclusions; IV heart rate, PR interval and systolic BP thresholds.
Boxed heading in the named 2016 label versus section 5.1 in selected newer labels; unchanged clinical withdrawal risk.
Reported common reactions and serious cardiovascular/respiratory reactions without pooling trial rates.
Negative chronotropes, CYP2D6 inhibitors, catecholamine depletion, additive hypotension, coordinated clonidine withdrawal, and reduced epinephrine response.
Observational pregnancy uncertainty, placental transfer, and neonatal beta-blockade effects.
Reported low milk transfer and monitoring for infant bradycardia or listlessness.
ER hypertension use from age 6; no established pediatric tartrate/IV use; cautious geriatric initiation.
Sexual adverse effects and hepatic/renal dosing distinctions.
Preferential beta-1 blockade, reduced cardiac oxygen demand, incomplete selectivity, and ER delivery.
CYP2D6 disposition, product-label half-life ranges, urinary metabolites, and distribution.
BP, HR and ECG monitoring; HF assessment during titration; glucose, interactions, hepatic review, and ischemia during taper.
Continuous use, tartrate meal timing, next scheduled missed dose without doubling, withdrawal, alertness, surgery, and breathing symptoms.
Tartrate-equivalent strength expression, succinate salt, tablet appearance/imprint, and exact NDC.
Selected tartrate and succinate tablet strengths, scoring, and IV concentration.
Product-specific temperatures, excursions, and light/moisture/heat protection.

resolved_source_findings.detail: Repackager version 1, effective 2026-07-27, section 16 incorrectly describes metformin 500 mg. Excluded its product-identification data. Traced source NDC 62332-114 to Alembic set ID 24837d82-0f3f-4482-9af0-31e5f675c30f and verified coherent metoprolol forms, imprints and NDCs.

Selected newer Alembic and Toprol-XL labels retain cessation warning in section 5.1 without a boxed heading; the linked 2016 tartrate label carries a boxed warning. No blanket boxed-status claim is made.

scope_exclusions: ER sprinkle capsules and additional manufacturers require their own labels; no capsule swallowing/tube instructions generalized.

AF, SVT, migraine prophylaxis, and other off-label dose protocols are outside this reference. The public historical ACC toolkit supports recognition of AF rate control only; current full 2023 guideline access was blocked by publisher/PMC browser checks, so its full text was not claimed read.
Brand Lopressor labels are not used to erase ingredient-level tartrate HTN/angina/MI indications.
clinical_review: Every published block checked against full relevant public label sections and the accessible professional references listed. Scope-limited source review, not an independent clinician sign-off.
